saw_lines: Cleaning buyers switch brands once, when a friend, a review or a price check convinces them, then refill the same bottle.
So trust decides the click, and an ad that skips your 120,000 reviews gives a new buyer nothing to check.
Your site shows over 120,000 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so print 120,000 reviews on the creative and open new ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows over 120,000 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so new buyers lack a reason to trust Koh. Print 120,000 reviews on the creative and open new ads with a shower or oven quote.

Your site lists free shipping over $119, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a first buyer clicks without knowing the cost. Open new ads with the $119 threshold and say when the order arrives.
Your site shows prices from $10 to $175.65, yet 0 of 30 ads mention price or cost, so a shopper compares blind. Lead one ad with the price per refill against the spray they already buy, then test it.
One exact copy runs in 7 of 22 ads, and the spring cleaning opener starts 7 ads. Keep the body copy, but rewrite the opening line and creative in each ad, so each variant tests a new hook.

ads_1: Review-led creative with shipping answered in line one, tested against price per refill
